candidate_windows.window_text: In our implementations, our method uses the HuggingFace's Transformers library<sup>4</sup> to implement the the uncased BERT base and T5 base models. The learning rate is initialized as 1e-4 with a linear decay. We utilize the Adam algorithm (Kingma and Ba, 2014) to optimize model parameters. The batch size is set to 128. The hyper-parameter for the hinge loss in BCE loss is set to 2. The number of neighbors $K$ is set to 3. The number of training epochs is 100. Each experiment is conducted on NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs.
